$comment: Real, single-source-of-truth primitive color scale for itunda's design system. Base sourced by directly fetching Toss's own official TDS docs (tossmini-docs.toss.im/tds-mobile/foundation/colors), 2026-07-13 -- see docs/TOSS_ARCHITECTURE_FACTS.md §3 for the full sourcing note. green500 is itunda's own already-established value (TDS's full green scale isn't confirmed sourced). This file is read by generate-tokens.js, which writes into marked regions of IdsColors.kt (Android), IdsTheme.swift (iOS), and tokens.css (web) -- everything outside those marked regions (semantic aliases, dark-mode mappings, doc comments) is hand-authored and untouched by generation. Run `node packages/design-tokens/generate-tokens.js` after editing this file. blue/red 50/100/200 re-leveled 2026-07-21: the values above were Toss's OWN pre-overhaul TDS palette, carrying the exact flaw Toss's 7-years-later color rebuild fixed (toss.tech/article/tds-color-system-update) -- same numbered step, different hue, different perceived brightness (measured here: grey100 vs blue100/red100 contrast-vs-white spread was 22%, grey200 vs blue200/red200 was 50%, matching the ~1.1 vs ~1.34 contrast gap Toss reported for their own old grey100/red100). Fixed via the same technique Toss used -- OKLCH re-leveling, blending each tint's lightness 90% of the way toward grey's lightness at that step while holding hue/chroma direction fixed, then reducing chroma only as needed to stay in sRGB gamut. Only 50/100/200 were touched (the tint steps actually used side-by-side in chips/badges/list rows, where the unevenness is visible); 300-900 are unchanged brand-anchor colors. Post-fix spread vs grey is under 5% at every touched step, chroma retained is ~40-45% of the original (a full 100%-match was tried first and washed the brand hue out almost to white, since high lightness + real chroma falls outside sRGB gamut).
